item.title: Decatur City Council backs lawsuit dealing with Alabama’s simplified sellers use tax in special called meeting
item.description: At a special-called meeting on Monday, the Decatur City Council voted in favor of a resolution supporting a statewide lawsuit seeking changes to Alabama's simplified sellers' use tax (SSUT). The SSUT is an 8% tax applied to eligible sellers, such as online retailers. Currently, 50% of SSUT revenue is allocated to the state, with the remaining half being used to supplement municipalities (30%) and counties (20%) across Alabama. item.title: 'Ideal location': Eli Lilly and Company announces plans for $6 billion manufacturing facility in Huntsville
